patches.new:
# FF environment patch (CHANGES.md): the team's own pip fix of 29/10 - 2/11/2026, copied verbatim from
    # kaggle/FLAG_47b_voice_screen.ipynb (builder output of 2/11, the code of the Evaluation run 47rs-eval of 11/11).
    # 2/11: FLAG_50's fix of 29/10 (BEST/v1977/README.md §6; the FLAG_47b re-run smoke lost wespeaker the same way): one pip call
    # per package; the openai CLIP build fails on Kaggle's current image (setup.py needs pkg_resources) and, in a shared call, took wespeaker down with it (FLAG_103c smoke). CLIP then comes from a git clone (FLAG_103a smoke).
    !pip -q install --no-deps "git+https://github.com/wenet-e2e/wespeaker.git@9fecd6cb4f47475d01761d87c826298dff4ef18c" 2>&1 | tail -2
    !pip -q install --no-deps "git+https://github.com/openai/CLIP.git@d50d76daa670286dd6cacf3bcd80b5e4823fc8e1" 2>&1 | tail -2
    try:
        import clip
    except ModuleNotFoundError:
        import subprocess
        _oc = Path("/tmp/openai_clip")
        if not (_oc / "clip").exists():
            subprocess.run(["git", "clone", "-q", "https://github.com/openai/CLIP.git", str(_oc)], check=True)
            subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(_oc), "checkout", "-q", "d50d76daa670286dd6cacf3bcd80b5e4823fc8e1"], check=True)
            _f = _oc / "clip/clip.py"
            _f.write_text(_f.read_text().replace("from pkg_resources import packaging", "import packaging, packaging.version"))
        sys.path.insert(0, str(_oc))
        import clip
    import importlib.util                       # not `import wespeaker`: its frontends need s3prl (SimAMVoice stubs them first)
    assert importlib.util.find_spec("wespeaker") is not None, "wespeaker did not install"
    print("openai CLIP:", clip.__file__, "| wespeaker:", importlib.util.find_spec("wespeaker").origin, flush=True)
patches.why: on the current Kaggle image the openai CLIP build fails (its setup.py needs pkg_resources) and, in this shared pip call, takes wespeaker down with it (BEST/v1977/README.md §6). Same packages and commits (wespeaker@9fecd6c, CLIP@d50d76d), one pip call each; CLIP from a git clone at d50d76d when the pip build fails
patches.effect: none (same code at the same commits)

patches.old: with requests.get(ZIP_URL.format(k), headers={"Range": "bytes=0-0"}, allow_redirects=True, timeout=120, stream=True) as r:
patches.new: with requests.get(ZIP_URL.format(k), headers={"Range": "bytes=0-0", **({"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['HF_TOKEN']}"} if os.environ.get("HF_TOKEN") else {})}, allow_redirects=True, timeout=120, stream=True) as r:   # FF access (CHANGES.md #2): token header when HF_TOKEN is set
patches.why: ProgramComputer/voxceleb is gated today (403 for a token without accepted terms, 18/11/2026); the original resolved the zip URL without a token. With HF_TOKEN set, the resolve request carries it (requests drops the header on the redirect to the CDN host); same files
patches.effect: none (same files; without HF_TOKEN the request is the original one)
